name: eonrover
description: Eon Rover - a browser-based multiplayer space strategy game

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/databaseSafety.test.cjs test/verticalSliceSafety.test.cjs test/adminPlayerStatePage.test.cjs && npm run test --workspace @eonrover/shared && npm run test:config --workspace @eonrover/api && npm run test:config --workspace @eonrover/worker
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:api && npm run test:integration:worker
